reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it provides an instructional walkthrough for reaching Facebook support chat, including logging in, selecting support options, completing a chat form, and starting a conversation. The separate marketer contact frame is not connected to these support-chat instructions, and the material presents no investment, payment, or deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: How to Contact Facebook Chat Support | Instagram Chat Support | Facebook Customer Care? Full Process

For contacting Facebook Chat Support, Facebook Online Support, Facebook Customer Care or Instagram Chat Support, login to your Facebook account and use this link - https://www.facebook.com/business/help/support

opening.argument: The video links a consequential account-access workflow to a specific external action: viewers are told to log in, enter the supplied support URL, and proceed through “Get Started” and “Start Chat.” The process also requests a name, phone number, registered email, and ad account ID before conversation begins. That combination resembles a low-barrier verification or access flow in which users surrender account-related information in exchange for promised support, even though the material does not clearly establish a reward or financial return.

citations.quote: login to your Facebook account and use this link - https://www.facebook.com/business/help/support

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material an instructional walkthrough does not resolve the risk created by the requested sequence. The video directs viewers to log in, provide multiple identifying fields, and initiate a chat through a claimed support channel. The fact that the process is presented as a tutorial does not itself prove that the destination, data request, or resulting interaction is harmless.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The described action is support access, not a reward, asset acquisition, or income opportunity. The source explicitly identifies the destination as support and asks viewers to use a Facebook account, while the frames show ordinary support categories and a chat form. Those facts do not establish that users are promised anything of value for completing the flow.

citations.quote: For contacting Facebook Chat Support, Facebook Online Support, Facebook Customer Care or Instagram Chat Support

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: a branded support identity, a direct URL, an account login, collection of phone and email information, and a prompt to start a conversation with a representative. The video also says the representative will join after the viewer types a response. While no reward is stated, this is still a low-friction funnel into an account-linked interaction, and the evidence does not rule out deceptive collection or misrepresentation of what the viewer will receive.

citations.quote: Facebook Chat Support, Facebook Online Support, Facebook Customer Care or Instagram Chat Support

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense treats the support framing as dispositive, but the relevant signals are the requested login, personal details, account identifier, and chat initiation. A branded appearance and a support label do not independently verify the interaction. The video also promotes a separate marketing identity and contact path, which makes the overall presentation more promotional than a neutral help reference.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These are ordinary steps for contacting platform support, not evidence of a low-barrier reward scheme. The page presents support categories, and the form identifies the fields as part of starting a chat. The promise that a representative will join concerns assistance, not money, an asset, or a withdrawal.

opening.argument: Although the video adopts a step-by-step educational format, it also functions as promotion for a marketer and its services. The description asks viewers to subscribe, follow multiple social accounts, and visit a marketing website, while the closing frame invites contact for digital marketing enquiries. Combined with the support tutorial and its requested account interaction, this steers viewers toward participation and contact rather than merely explaining a neutral process.

citations.quote: Kindly subscribe to our channel. Press the bell icon and get notified about new publications.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The instructional appearance should not obscure the promotional conversion points. Viewers are asked to subscribe, follow several channels, visit a website, and contact the marketer. Those calls to action sit alongside a support-access workflow, so the content can reasonably be understood as steering users into an engagement funnel rather than simply documenting platform navigation.

citations.quote: Like and follow our FaceBook page

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotion of a channel or marketing service is not a promised reward, asset acquisition, or income scheme. The description's calls to subscribe and follow are separate from the support instructions, and the closing frame identifies a marketing contact. Nothing cited links those promotional requests to a payment, return, or promised benefit.
